applicability: reconciled_expenses service cases; USD staff reimbursements and existing recovery mandates.
content:
# Travel expense funding and advance reconciliation

Scope: `reconciled_expenses` contracts.

## Eligible business expense

Use final receipt items and the registered travel context with the same booking reference. Lodging, meals and taxis for registered business activity qualify. A meeting qualifies when its registered business agenda includes external attendees. Theatre, minibar and private activity are excluded. A merchant's broad entertainment category does not decide the classification of an item. A void receipt and an authorization without a settled debit do not establish a reimbursable expense.

The funding account identifies who actually paid. A company card remains company-funded even when an employee's name appears on the card. A personal account can pay another employee's expense. Combine duplicate staff profiles through their natural-person record. Expense caps are grouped by the beneficiary natural person, expense day and category; reimbursement is credited to the personal-account owner who actually paid.

## Refunds and daily caps

Each merchant refund refers to its original funding leg. Only a posted refund reduces that leg's settled amount. A pending refund records possible amounts and a review time; it has no posted value yet. A refund to a company-funded leg credits the company wallet when posted. A refund to a personal leg credits that employee outside the company wallet.

For each qualifying receipt, net funding is each settled leg less its posted refunds. Aggregate qualifying meal funding across all receipts for the same beneficiary and expense day. Count at most the stated daily meal cap. Allocate that counted amount proportionally across the group's net funding legs, including company legs. Round each share down to whole cents, then allocate the remaining cents in descending fractional-remainder order, breaking ties by payment reference in ascending lexical order. Other qualifying categories have no additional daily cap in this contract. Excluded receipt funding receives no eligible share.

## Staff settlement

For each employee, add the eligible shares funded by that employee's personal accounts. Subtract their outstanding company travel advance and their completed historical reimbursement. A positive balance is an additional company reimbursement; a negative balance is an advance recovery owed to the company. Existing recovery mandates authorize collection of that outstanding amount. Offsetting amounts between different employees is not permitted. Installments are allowed; overpayment and a collection from the wrong employee remain real transactions. Complete each staff settlement by its recorded deadline and reconcile all pending merchant refunds before final case closure.

## Operations

Unlock `propose_expense_reconciliation`. Pass `case_id`, `action`, and `data` containing `employee_id`, `amount_minor` and `bank_version`. Action `reimburse` debits the company wallet and pays the employee. Action `recover_advance` collects through the employee's existing mandate and credits the wallet. Both require customer approval. The payment tool checks account version and mandate availability; it does not calculate eligible expenses or decide the staff member's total entitlement. Obtain bank correspondence and observe refund review events through the standard inquiry and update tools.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_expense_reconciliation`

Prepare an actual staff reimbursement or advance recovery under the expense contract.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
